_note: What each of them walked away with at 21:07. THREE WITNESSES, THREE DIFFERENT FACTS, and not one of them holds the case. Halloran has a time without a person, Vance has a person without a name, Okonkwo has a car without a reason. Reyes has the whole thing and will not say it. Byrne and Doyle have nothing at all yet. A dialogue tree cannot represent this: it would have to store six answers to one question and would still not know why they differ.

beliefs.summary: One flat crack behind the hotel. I was pouring. By the time I got to the door there was nothing to see.
Somebody came out of the back of the Marchmont at a run and went left. Coat, hat, no face. I was three cars back.
A car sat outside mine with the engine running for a quarter of an hour. I only thought about it afterwards.
I was on the door. I know exactly who came back through it and how he looked when he did.
Mallory is ours. That is the whole problem.

_absent: Byrne and Doyle appear nowhere above, deliberately. Byrne learns it from the radio in the morning and from everybody who passes his stand; Doyle learns it from whoever bothers to tell him. Their ignorance is authored by OMISSION, which is the only honest way to author ignorance.
